description: Creative Workflow Engine v2 — Universal Execution Planning for Creative AI

routesToMount.note: Admin router — /definitions/* and /plans/* are protected by explicit adminAuth inside the router itself (belt-and-suspenders). Call setDefinitionResolver(fn) after mounting.

Public router — must be mounted BEFORE adminAuthWithExceptions (or the path /api/ai/creative-workflow/v2/public/progress must be added to PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES in middleware/adminAuth.ts). Handles only GET /public/progress with token-based auth.

sidebarItems.label: Workflow Engine v2
sidebarItems.note: Team 01 does not ship a frontend page. Optional — wire by Team 24 if a UI is desired.

integrationOrder: Run migration draft in this order: STEP 1 cwf_workflow_definitions → STEP 2 cwf_execution_plans (FK to step 1) → STEP 3 cwf_plan_events (FK to step 2) → STEP 4 indexes
Mount creativeWorkflowPublicRouter at /api/ai/creative-workflow/v2 BEFORE adminAuthWithExceptions (public endpoint)
Add '/api/ai/creative-workflow/v2/public' to PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES in middleware/adminAuth.ts so it bypasses admin key check
Mount creativeWorkflowV2Router at /api/ai/creative-workflow/v2 AFTER adminAuthWithExceptions (admin endpoint)
Call setDefinitionResolver(dbBackedFn) to swap in-memory definition store for DB
Call setContextTokenResolver(fn) to enable token → contextId resolution for public progress
Call setPublicPlanReader(fn) to enable contextId-filtered plan reads for public progress
Wire EventBusPort adapter to real aiEventBusService.publishSafe/publish
Wire QueuePort adapter to real queueManagerService.enqueue/cancelJob
Wire WorkerPort adapter to real workerClusterService.getCapabilities
Wire DispatcherPort adapter to real jobDispatcherService.getStatus
Register OpenAPI fragment paths in root openapi.yaml (all operationIds prefixed cwfV2)

remediationLog.finding: P1-01 — No explicit auth middleware on admin routers
remediationLog.fix: Added adminAuth import + router.use(adminAuth) as first middleware in both definitions.ts and plans.ts. Belt-and-suspenders: enforces auth even if global mount-point middleware is misconfigured.

remediationLog.finding: P1-02 — IDOR vulnerability: public execution progress accepts plan ID from URL
remediationLog.fix: Created publicProgress.ts with GET /public/progress?token=<contextToken>. contextToken is resolved SERVER-SIDE to { contextId, contextType } via injected resolver. Plans are fetched by server-resolved contextId only — no plan ID is accepted from the request. Unknown/expired tokens fail closed (401). Separate router (creativeWorkflowPublicRouter) with no admin auth — token is the sole credential.

remediationLog.finding: P1-03 — OpenAPI operationIds not unique, no cwfV2 prefix
remediationLog.fix: Renamed all 19 operationIds to have cwfV2 prefix (e.g. cwfV2ListDefinitions, cwfV2CreatePlan, cwfV2GetPublicProgress). All are globally unique.

Added STEP 1/2/3/4 ordering comments with FK dependency explanations: STEP 1 cwf_workflow_definitions (no FK) → STEP 2 cwf_execution_plans (FK to step 1) → STEP 3 cwf_plan_events (FK to step 2) → STEP 4 indexes.

remediationLog.finding: Previous remediation — pagination on list endpoints
remediationLog.fix: GET /definitions and GET /plans both support limit/offset pagination (default 50, max 200).
MAX_WORKFLOW_NODES=500 guard in buildExecutionPlan throws immediately for oversized definitions.

knownRisks.description: WorkflowDefinitions and ExecutionPlans are stored in-memory (Map). All data is lost on server restart until Team 24 runs the migration and wires the DB adapter.
knownRisks.mitigation: Run migration draft + call setDefinitionResolver() before production use.

knownRisks.description: creativeWorkflowPublicRouter MUST be mounted before adminAuthWithExceptions OR the path /public/progress must be added to PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES. If mounted after admin middleware without exception, the public endpoint will require an admin key.
knownRisks.mitigation: See integrationOrder step 2-3. Add path exception or mount before global middleware.

knownRisks.description: Default resolver returns null for every token (fail-closed). If Team 24 does not call setContextTokenResolver(), the public progress endpoint will return 401 for all requests.
knownRisks.mitigation: Call setContextTokenResolver(fn) during wiring. fn must return { contextId, contextType } for valid tokens.

knownRisks.description: QueuePort, EventBusPort, DispatcherPort, and WorkerPort are interfaces only. The engine does not auto-dispatch jobs or publish events until Team 24 provides adapter implementations.
knownRisks.mitigation: NullPort stubs are provided for testing. Wire adapters during integration.

knownRisks.description: Node-level endpoints (running/completed/skipped/ready) are behind adminAuth but ideally should also validate a worker-specific token to prevent any admin-key holder from manually advancing node states.
knownRisks.mitigation: Team 24 should add worker-token validation on node transition routes during integration.

knownRisks.description: When multiple branches have equal estimated duration, all are marked critical (zero slack). This is correct CPM behaviour.
knownRisks.mitigation: Accepted. Operators should set distinct estimatedDurationMs values.
